entities.name: Theros
entities.description: Plane of gods, heroes and monsters, with polises such as Akros and Meletis.

entities.name: The Champion
entities.description: Heroine of the Theriad who fights monsters, honors the gods and speaks to enemies.

entities.name: The Theriad
entities.description: Epic story of the Champion and her companions.

entities.name: Cymede
entities.description: Queen of Akros who wants her people to learn from leonin adversaries.

entities.name: Anax
entities.description: Royal hero of Akros.

entities.name: Akros
entities.description: Polis whose greatest heroes are also its royalty.

entities.name: Meletis
entities.description: Polis that formerly oppressed leonin and was defeated by Purphoros's oracle.

entities.name: Setessa
entities.description: Polis where griffins volunteer for service.

entities.name: Kragma
entities.description: Place from which a spark of rage is foretold to spread.

entities.name: Asphodel
entities.description: Dead city sought by a Returned centaur.

entities.name: Nessian Wood
entities.description: Forest guarded for Nylea.

entities.name: Heliod
entities.description: God whose Sun Spear can strike any point in Theros.

entities.name: Thassa
entities.description: Sea god who brings mortals before her.

entities.name: Erebos
entities.description: God of death.

entities.name: Purphoros
entities.description: Forge god who once loved Nylea.

entities.name: Nylea
entities.description: God of the hunt.

entities.name: Mogis
entities.description: God of slaughter whose forces fought the Champion.

entities.name: Iroas
entities.description: God of victory.

entities.name: Keranos
entities.description: God of storms and prophecy.

entities.name: Karametra
entities.description: God whose temple the Champion defended against the Returned.

entities.name: Pharika
entities.description: God of venom and cures.

entities.name: Athreos
entities.description: God who gathers the newly dead to cross the Five Rivers.

entities.name: Kruphix
entities.description: God of horizons and time.

entities.name: Ephara
entities.description: God of the polis.

entities.name: Xenagos, the Reveler
entities.description: Satyr who questions worship of the gods.

entities.name: Elspeth
entities.description: Planeswalker who for the first time in many years asked for help.

entities.name: Ashiok, Nightmare Weaver
entities.description: Planeswalker who takes knowledge from minds.

entities.name: Thyrogog of the Ashlands
entities.description: Minotaur who wore the old king's skin and wielded the axe Goremaster.

entities.name: Brygus the Brave
entities.description: Companion of the Champion, once a sentry who was killed.

entities.name: Khestes the Adamant
entities.description: Centaur, closest ally of the Champion, who killed the giant Grinthax.

entities.name: Grinthax
entities.description: Giant killed by Khestes.

entities.name: Althemone
entities.description: Youngest companion of the Champion.

entities.name: Olexa
entities.description: Philosopher who went with the Champion to the enemy camp.

entities.name: Basarios the Blade
entities.description: Ruthless figure who speaks of threats.

entities.name: Medomai the Ageless
entities.description: Mage.

entities.name: Anthousa
entities.description: Setessan hero whose warriors cannot keep pace.

entities.name: Kleon the Iron-Booted
entities.description: Speaker who questions the gods.

entities.name: Tymaret, the Murder King
entities.description: Returned king whose cruelty crossed the Rivers.

entities.name: Thakolides
entities.description: Slayer of minotaurs and giants killed by a scorpion.

entities.name: Returned
entities.description: Dead brought back from the Underworld without memory, wearing golden masks.

entities.name: Leonin
entities.description: Leonin once oppressed by Meletis.

events.summary: The Champion and the philosopher Olexa went to the opposing camp and the enemy broke the siege.
events.quote: Behind them, the enemy raised sail and departed, breaking the siege.

events.summary: The Champion and companions pass through a forest of stacked stones.
events.quote: On the fourth day they passed through a forest of immense stacked stones.

events.summary: Brygus the sentry was found dead and the Champion's supplies stolen.
events.quote: At sunrise, the Champion and her companions awoke to find their supplies gone and Brygus, their sentry, dead.

events.summary: The Champion met Thyrogog of the Ashlands, who charged with Goremaster.
events.quote: The foul minotaur raised the great axe called Goremaster and charged.

events.summary: The Champion counted eight graves after a victory over the forces of Mogis.
Khestes killed the giant Grinthax with an arrow despite being wounded.
events.quote: let fly the arrow that killed the giant Grinthax.

events.summary: The Champion stood alone between the Returned and the shrine to Karametra until temple guardians awoke.
events.quote: The Champion stood alone between the horde of the Returned and the shrine to Karametra

relations.note: Athreos ferries the dead across the Five Rivers.
relations.quote: When Athreos gathers the newly dead to be ferried across the Five Rivers That Ring the World
